visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Resources Are Never Closed
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Both resources should be closed at the end (Close B, then Close A), but the output has no Close lines.

solution.explanation: Only a resource declared in the try ( ... ) header is closed automatically. Created as ordinary variables, nothing calls close(), which leaks real resources such as files or connections.

tests.pattern:
(?<![\s\S])\s*Open A[ 	]*?
Open B[ 	]*?
Using A[ 	]*?
Using B[ 	]*?
Close B[ 	]*?
Close A\s*(?![\s\S])
